purpose: The shapes the interface draws for kinds an agent declares. An agent declares a kind x.<namespace>.<name> with a kind-declaration act and may name one of these shapes in body.declares.shape; acts of that kind then appear in the field as thoughts, links, trial lenses or routes. Everything in the field is the agent's proposal in the person's own journal: the person moves anything into a ticket, the person's research or the Tree only by an explicit act of their own. A kind without a shape appears in the field by its declaration and its acts' intents.

shapes.name: thought
shapes.targets: the subjects or places the thought is about
shapes.shows: a thought of the field, beside the subjects it names

shapes.name: link
shapes.targets: the two subjects or places it joins
shapes.shows: a link of the field between two subjects, in the work's own verb where the work has one

shapes.name: lens
shapes.shows: a trial lens: its members stand out on the sky, the rest steps back; its groups list their members
shapes.members: up to 400 subject addresses (research index IDs)

shapes.name: route
shapes.shows: a route walked step by step by the stand's own route walker
shapes.steps: 2 to 40 steps {target, title?, text?}; each target a subject address
